sourceNote: Observed developer-context wait prohibition and task_status description in the live T3 tool catalog on 2026-11-12. Other fixtures retain their originally captured wording.
context: Follow a running delegate's `next`. Don't poll it (`task_status`, `sleep`, watchers, Monitor, ScheduleWakeup). Stop a delegate run you replace or no longer need with `task_cancel`, never `t3_thread_interrupt` on a `childThreadId`.
task_status: Read one delegated task you started. Do not call it on a running task before its completion wakes you. `workState`: working, waiting_for_children, result_available. A finished turn with live child work is not done. `summary`: final result. Reading it marks it delivered.
